pr_title: Allow deleting the current song in multiplayer room
pr_body:
Fixes #18828 
The operation consists in swapping the first and second elements in the list.
We first delete the second element after caching its data, then we edit the first element with that data.
The fact that there is an edit request allows refreshing the new first entry for everyone
pr_comments: It's going to be very hard to accept a change like this without test coverage.

> The operation consists in swapping the first and second elements in the list.
> We first delete the second element after caching its data, then we edit the first element with that data.

This is not an acceptable workaround and I wish you'd have asked in the issue thread before going off in this direction.

I think this PR should be closed.

> It's going to be very hard to accept a change like this without test coverage.

I just wanted to make sure that this was what you wanted the fix to look like before making that test.

As @bdach mentioned, this isn't that complicated of an operation. Most of the changes are going to be server-side only, and likely consist of removing this check:
https://github.com/ppy/osu-server-spectator/blob/d6cfecbac12805dd2963c735862f8b230a66b035/osu.Server.Spectator/Hubs/MultiplayerQueue.cs#L191-L192

It will need additional checks to make sure that the item can't be deleted during play/if there's only one item/etc. I'm actually not sure if `EditPlaylistItem` prevents the same - I was conscious of it at the time but I can't find anything in a 30s cursory glance that prevents it.

Going to close as this is taking the wrong direction.

issue_context.title: Skip the current map in a multiplayer lobby
issue_context.body:
Let's open an issue for this one, since it's probably not that hard to get it working for the case that there is more than 1 item in the queue. ### Discussed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/discussions/18825
Originally posted by **apollo-dw** June 24, 2022 ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/83023433/175386084-8b26e1c1-252c-41bb-baab-eb98d1a4975b.png) i was playing round robin - for some reason you can't skip the map that's next up but you can remove all the other ones afterwards which certainly seems strange

review_comments: To illustrate why this is wrong: think what happens if the removal of the second item succeeds but the nested edit of the first one doesn't, for whatever reason.
